messages.subject: Expenses for the Truro trade show

messages.subject: Pension statements
messages.bodyPreview: Annual pension statements will be on the payroll portal from Monday.

messages.subject: December payroll dates
messages.bodyPreview: December pay goes out on the 18th, so timesheets close on Friday 11 December.

messages.subject: Cold weather PPE
messages.bodyPreview: Thermal gloves and hats are in stores from today. Sign for them on the sheet.

messages.subject: Car park gritting
messages.bodyPreview: The car park is gritted from 04:30 on frosty mornings. Please use the lit path from the gate.

messages.subject: Phishing test results
messages.bodyPreview: Only two people clicked the test link this time. A three-minute refresher video is on the intranet.

messages.subject: Christmas party tickets
messages.bodyPreview: Tickets are on your desks. Partners are welcome; let me know numbers by 4 December.

messages.subject: Your new laptop
messages.bodyPreview: Your replacement laptop is ready. Bring the old one and its charger to the swap on 4 December at 15:00.

messages.subject: Quiz night helpers
messages.bodyPreview: We need two people to mark answers and one to run the lifeboat raffle on the 11th.

messages.subject: First aid course places
messages.bodyPreview: Three places left on the first aid at work course on 19 January. Reply if you would like one.

messages.subject: Seasonal driver starters
messages.bodyPreview: Kit and Lowdy start as seasonal drivers on Monday 7 December. Please make them welcome.

messages.subject: Chiller 3 pressure test
messages.bodyPreview: Expect some noise from the chiller 3 room during the pressure test on 16 December.

messages.subject: Credit note: November short on clementines
messages.bodyPreview: Hello, further to the Quayside claim: the credit note for the November short on clementines now stands at 64.50 pounds, now that the third pallet has been recounted. Please update your records. Pentrae Growers accounts
